description: This source file implements a credential cache mechanism for a Git-like application, handling UNIX socket communication with a cache daemon, with functions for starting the daemon, sending requests, and executing command actions like get, store, and erase.

methods.name: int connection_closed(int error)
methods.description: Checks if the error indicates the connection was closed, with implementations differing for Windows and Unix-like systems.

methods.name: int connection_fatally_broken(int error)
methods.description: Determines if the error indicates a fatal connection break, differing between Windows and Unix.

methods.name: int send_request(const char * socket,const struct strbuf * out)
methods.description: Sends a request over a UNIX socket and reads the response, outputting data to stdout.

methods.name: void spawn_daemon(const char * socket)
methods.description: Starts the credential cache daemon process and verifies it started successfully.

methods.name: void do_cache(const char * socket,const char * action,int timeout,int flags)
methods.description: Performs cache operations like get, store, or erase by communicating with the daemon, spawning it if necessary.

methods.name: char * get_socket_path(void)
methods.description: Retrieves the path of the UNIX socket used for credential cache communication.

methods.name: void announce_capabilities(void)
methods.description: Announces credential capabilities to the caller.

methods.name: int cmd_credential_cache(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command entry point for credential-cache commands, parsing options and dispatching actions.
